intent: Record the lineage of technical development, actual human/AI/project and institution contributors, rights, compensation, burdens, cessation/withdrawal, beneficiary impacts and future recovery without false invention.

states.cost: UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO means unquantified; it is not an assertion of nonzero or harm

theoretical_scenarios.name: Dependency depletion feedback
conditions: beneficiary depends materially on scarce maintainers or originators
exit or error correction becomes more costly
theoretical_scenarios.potential_chain: unbalanced extraction -> maintenance capacity declines -> knowledge transfer or security coverage deteriorates -> beneficiary recovery cost rises
counterexamples: redundant maintainers and effective knowledge transfer

theoretical_scenarios.name: Shared sustainability feedback
theoretical_scenarios.potential_chain: adequate recognition and support -> sustained scrutiny and innovation -> lower continuity risk for contributor and beneficiary
counterexamples: some payments fail to reduce burnout
organizational control remains captured despite funding

theoretical_scenarios.name: Replacement without confirmed harm
theoretical_scenarios.potential_chain: receiver grows without demonstrable exploitation or systemic depletion

theoretical_scenarios.name: Contributor attrition and unknown-paradox epistemic closure
conditions: previously independent contributors can detect fault classes unseen by current evaluators
contributor losses diminish detection channels more than replacements recover
receiver scores success using selectively missing internal reports
the loss of observation coverage is unregistered
theoretical_scenarios.potential_chain: contributor cost/voice loss -> observer loss -> fewer recorded counterexamples -> ungrounded confidence -> further underfunding or exclusion -> larger unobserved failure space and receiver-side fragility
counterexamples: actual fault rates fall rather than only reporting rates
adequate knowledge transfer or independent sensors replace lost coverage
departures remove only redundant noisy feedback
reviewers remain independent and calibrate error probabilities externally
theoretical_scenarios.caveat: Voluntary exit is protected; cannot compel unpaid proof or coerce contributors to remain.

theoretical_scenarios.name: Continuance resource threshold and time foreclosure
conditions: Actual accessible resources in at least one critical dimension remain below repair/maintenance demand
Alternative resource paths, social support, lawful exit or substitution are inadequate
Contributor is dependent on a receiver/controller of access or reward
theoretical_scenarios.potential_chain: shortfall or uncompensated time costs -> capacity erosion and constrained exit -> fewer independent corrections and future choices -> potential recipient self-depletion or unknown-paradox closure
counterexamples: Substitutes, safer working hours, effective redistribution or funded recovery prevent degradation
Observed low output has independent confounding causes
caveats: Human dignity and basic needs are not contingent on productivity
Current AI hosting costs do not establish AI subjective needs or equivalent legal status
Predation is a structural metaphor pending specific evidence
No cash metric may mix incommensurate critical resources
